description: r.main is limited to 2 live tasks while t.a and t.b sleep. t.a wakes, spawns t.a.c1 and t.a.c2 and ends in the same poll. Admission at the next step counts live tasks then: t.a has completed, so t.a.c1 is admitted (2 live with t.b) and t.a.c2 is refused (RegionAtCapacity, ASX_E_ADMISSION_LIMIT on its spawn step).
